Then, in $\mathbb{R}$, $j_{k,n} + \Delta_k J_{k,n} = 2\sigma_k^n$ and $j_{k,n} - \Delta_k J_{k,n} = 2(-2)^n / \sigma_k^n$, and, in $\mathbb{Z}$, $j_{k,n}^2 - (k^2 + 8) J_{k,n}^2 = (-2)^{n+2}$.

Then for every natural number $n$, $2\,\mathcal{J}_{k,n}(a, b) = a\,j_{k,n} + (2b - ak)\,J_{k,n}$.
